items.name: Project-Cicada-Image-Steganography
items.description: Inspired by the emergence of the Cicada 3301 group, I thought a fun way to introduce myself to cryptography/steganography was to create a program that conceals text, images, sound, and videos onto one master image. My main strategy in concealing information is Least Significant Bit manipulation, which isn't necessarily secure from image distortion, but it helps demonstrate obfuscation and retrieval of data. My final plans include an overall application that is both terminal and GUI based, all in Python3.
